subject: Charter Revision of Council Oversight and Appointments
overview: The subcommittee refined draft language for Charter Articles 2 and 3, focusing on balancing executive authority with legislative oversight. Decisions included removing council-initiated board member removals, granting the council subpoena power, and authorizing the hiring of independent council staff.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the November 30 meeting.

items.title: Removal Procedures for Multi-Member Boards
items.summary: Discussed feedback from the full committee regarding proposed procedures for the removal of members from city boards and commissions.

items.title: Council-Initiated Removal Provision
items.summary: Approved a motion to remove a previously proposed provision that would have allowed the City Council to initiate the removal of board members by a unanimous vote.

items.title: Overturning Mayoral Removals
items.summary: Decided to retain language permitting the City Council to overturn mayoral removals of board members by a supermajority vote.

items.title: Board Residency and Recruitment Requirements
items.summary: Agreed to include charter language requiring board members to be city residents and requiring the mayor to post all vacancies on the city website.

items.title: Council Staffing and Auditor Position
items.summary: Opted to grant the City Council broad authority to hire its own staff and consultants by ordinance rather than establishing a specific City Auditor position.

items.title: Clerk of the Council Designation
items.summary: Agreed to remove the specific 'Clerk of the Council' title from the draft to provide the council more flexibility in staffing, while the City Clerk continues current duties.

items.title: Term Lengths and Limits
items.summary: Recommended four-year mayoral terms and two-year council terms, while deferring the final debate on term limits to the full committee.

items.title: Councilor Attendance and Enforcement
items.summary: Discussed recurring councilor attendance issues but determined that the charter cannot effectively compel meeting participation beyond democratic elections.

items.title: Access to Information and Subpoena Power
items.summary: Approved draft language granting the City Council the power to subpoena witnesses and evidence during oversight investigations.
